title: Matterbridge Homey
description: matterbridge-homey: expose Athom Homey Pro devices to Matter

address.title: Homey Address
address.description: Local address of your Homey Pro, e.g. http://192.168.1.50 or https://192-168-1-50.homey.homeylocal.com

token.title: API Key
token.description: Homey API key. Create it in the Homey web app (my.homey.app) under Settings > API Keys. It needs at least the 'View devices', 'Control devices' and 'View zones' permissions.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

zoneWhiteList.title: Zone White List
zoneWhiteList.description: Only the devices in these Homey zones (rooms) will be exposed. Sub-zones are included. If the list is empty, devices from all zones are exposed.

lightList.title: Light List
lightList.description: The devices in the list will be exposed like lights, whatever their Homey class (devices need the onoff or dim capability).

outletList.title: Outlet List
outletList.description: The devices in the list will be exposed like outlets (plugs), whatever their Homey class (devices need the onoff capability).

capabilityBlackList.title: Capability Black List
capabilityBlackList.description: The Homey capabilities in the list will not be exposed for any device (e.g. meter_power or measure_temperature.outdoorTemperature).

deviceCapabilityBlackList.title: Device Capability Black List
deviceCapabilityBlackList.description: Homey capabilities not to be exposed for a single device. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the list add all the capabilities to exclude.

additionalProperties.description: List of Homey capabilities not to be exposed for this device (e.g. measure_power).

exposeNewDevices.title: Expose New Devices
exposeNewDevices.description: Expose the devices added to Homey right away, without restarting Matterbridge. The white list, black list and zone white list still apply. When off, new devices are exposed after the next restart.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
